title: Setup settings page: an action button whose handler declares confirmText runs without asking
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

Filed by the `domain:ui#3` seat from the out-of-scope finding of #30299's card thread (os-dev-report 6655442656). Declared ≠ enforced.

## Observed

- The spec's settings specifier handler (`SpecifierHandlerSchema`, its `http` and `action` arms) declares `confirmText`: "Confirm dialog text before invoking (omit = no confirm)".
- The console's settings field renderer (`SettingsField`, the `action_button` row) never reads `confirmText`, so an action declared with a confirmation runs on click with none.

## Wanted

- An `action_button` whose handler declares `confirmText` shows that text in a confirmation before invoking; cancel invokes nothing. No `confirmText` keeps today's behaviour.
- A test pins both.

Refs: #30299
Dedupe words: confirmText, action_button, SettingsField, settings confirm
